description.value:
You center yourself, gather chakra, and refill an exhausted well. Choose how many actions to spend (1, 2, or 3); you regain that many expended spell slots, distributed across any ranks of jutsu you can normally cast. You cannot regain a slot of a higher rank than your maximum spell rank.

Frequency equal to your remaining @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtChakraReser0]{Chakra Reserves} for the day. Heritages, feats, and equipment that increase your Chakra Reserves let you Charge Chakra more times per long rest.

Heightened (+1) The maximum number of slots you can regain in one cast increases by 1 (cap 6 at +3).
